about_short_description.short_description: Fertiglobe focuses on the production and marketing of nitrogen-based fertilizers, including urea and ammonia.

product.name: Granular Urea
product.description: A solid nitrogen fertilizer with approximately 46% nitrogen content, produced from ammonia and carbon dioxide under high pressure and temperature.

product.name: Ammonia
product.description: A colorless gas composed of nitrogen and hydrogen, used as a key industrial chemical and nitrogen fertilizer, produced under high temperature and pressure.

product.name: Renewable Ammonia
product.description: Ammonia produced using hydrogen derived from electrolysis powered by renewable electricity, reducing carbon emissions.

product.name: Low Carbon Ammonia
product.description: Ammonia produced using low-carbon hydrogen derived from natural gas with carbon capture technology to reduce emissions.

product.name: Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)
product.description: A non-hazardous aqueous urea solution used to reduce nitrogen oxide emissions from diesel engines, consisting of about 32.5% urea and 67.5% deionized water.
